method: Manual whole-file reading of UiDialogs.cpp, upgrading prior ApplyPages-only excerpt credit. Pinned bytes verified. No Windows runtime.
findings: PickFile uses4096wchar buffer, pipe-to-null filter conversion and csv default extension. Open mode requires existing path but does not set OFN_FILEMUSTEXIST here; cancellation and common-dialog error both return nullopt. Long-path-aware manifest does not remove this buffer limit.

PickFolders uses COM filesystem-only folder picker and optional multiselect; any failed item/path extraction discards whole result. Cancel and COM errors both return empty vector. PickColor keeps16custom colors in process-static storage, commits result only on chooser success.

Property pages are created lazily; sheet dimensions use the first successfully created page, not maximum dimensions of every page template. Later pages are fitted to that rectangle. Actual clipping across languages/DPI unqualified.
Caption parser bounds-checks standard/extended dialog template word ranges, menu/class encodings and null-terminated title. It does not execute a complete dialog-template schema validator.

ApplyPages prepares all created pages, then confirms, runs all BeforeApply, all CommitApply, clears modified flags, then AfterApply and OnApplied. No exception rollback; uncreated pages are not prepared/committed. Prior six synthetic ordering controls remain narrower than actual Windows settings qualification.
Page switching checks creation before hiding other pages and reverts tab selection on failure; keyboard CtrlTab/PageUp/PageDown wraps and attempts focus restoration to valid tab control.

Command handling suppresses further commands while applying; cancel requests modal exit. Apply button reflects any modified page flag, including flags of pages not yet created. Creation/API failures are only partially surfaced in setup.
limits: No native file/folder/color chooser, cancellation/error differentiation, page creation, template parser boundary or settings runtime tests executed.
No foreign production code adopted; native pHash investigation deferred. Global completed repository count remains147/500.
